summary: Iteration 2 backend + mobile frontend testing for AWS CloudForge Cards. 14/14 pytest tests passed against public URL covering: 33 services incl. 2 AI cards (Bedrock, SageMaker), new rating grades (Broken Architecture/Needs Refactor/Partial Fit/Production Candidate/Well-Architected), 'Overengineering Penalty' label rename, ideal_combos resolved to full service objects in /api/game/score response, ml_batch combo includes SageMaker. Mobile (390x844) Playwright run confirms: no horizontal overflow on Landing/Play/Leaderboard/HowToPlay; footer-disclaimer text matches spec; nav-burger + nav-mobile-menu drawer + nav-play-mobile work; category-filters row has all 9 chips (All/Compute/Storage/Database/Security/Analytics/Networking/Integration/AI); Networking filter narrows to Network-category cards; selection-tray appears on first selection with tray-card-* chips and Submit Design button; Selected counter renders as 'Selected · 3/5' (visible in screenshot).
action_items: Main agent self-verify post-submit score view selectors (round-rating-label, got-right, to-improve, ideal-architecture, subscore-overengineering-penalty) — testing agent's Playwright Submit click landed on a chip button due to selector ambiguity inside selection-tray (it contains multiple non-disabled buttons: chip-remove buttons + the Submit Design button). Consider adding data-testid='submit-design-button' on the Submit Design CTA to make tests/automation robust.

AI filter test in random hand returned 0 visible cards because /api/game/deal randomized hand did not include bedrock/sagemaker — not a bug, but consider seeding hand to include >=1 card per requested category for better UX coverage (or a small note in UI when filter yields 0).
critical_code_review_comments: selection-tray contains multiple buttons (chip removal buttons + Submit Design). Add a unique data-testid (e.g., submit-design-button) on the primary CTA to disambiguate from chip buttons.
Random hand from /api/game/deal does not guarantee category coverage — filter chips for empty categories show no cards silently; consider 'No services in this category for this hand' empty state.
Selected counter uses '·' separator ('Selected · 3/5') — fine visually; tests should accept that format.
GET /api/game/deal returns 404 for unknown scenario but POST /api/game/score returns 400 — slight inconsistency (carried over from iter1).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (score-view testids not directly asserted due to test script selector ambiguity; tray + filters + nav + overflow + footer all verified)

seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_player2 (score 77.5) into leaderboard via tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest; sourced from /app/frontend/.env). Run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. For Playwright score-view verification, scope Submit button by visible text 'Submit Design' rather than `[data-testid=selection-tray] button:not([disabled])`, since tray also contains chip-remove buttons.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found; only a minor automation robustness suggestion: add data-testid='submit-design-button' to disambiguate the Submit CTA inside the selection-tray.
